name: yt-vat-and-goods-imports
description: Mayotte reference distinguishing the absence of local VAT from customs and octroi de mer obligations on goods. Explains EU customs-territory membership, import declarations, separate destination taxation and the need for tariff classification and exemption evidence. Uses French customs guidance and flags conflicting VAT recodification dates in retrieved tax publications rather than prescribing an unverified future invoice citation. Services, detailed valuation, product tariffs, electronic reporting and independent accountant review are outside this initial source-cited draft; no claim of comprehensive territorial coverage is made.
